svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for Product Modernisation. Three upright versions of the same product screen stand one in front of the other, growing from small and pale at the back left to large and current at the front right. All three hold the same parts in the same places. The first, faded, shows them as plain light blocks; the second has them designed but nothing highlighted yet; the third, in dark blue, is a dashboard with three KPI cards, a bar chart with one lime bar, a list and a lime progress ring. All three keep the same left-hand menu, and its pinned item, in lime, sits in the same place on each, joined across them by a faint blue dotted line.
